propositions: Code review strategy must compile DiscoveryStagePlan units from immutable CriteriaSnapshot and execute through shared discovery kernel, selecting each criterion exactly once while respecting effective disables, project applicability, and explicit file globs.
Positive authored usd_budget must be enforced with shed units recorded; omission remains uncapped; zero is schema-invalid and rejected by validation.

After one local criterion failure, remaining independent criteria execute and successes survive; blocking-capable missing coverage yields INDETERMINATE unless real block exists; advisory-only missing coverage may pass.
Code-review response shape, base-reviewer topology, one-hop Round B path, per-overlay context, sequential scheduling, and absence of checkpoints must remain unchanged from pre-cutover contract.
Internal code-review journal persists versioned discovery trace and comparison mismatches from expand-contract shadow projection without exposing trace fields to public review response.
Systemic configuration/provider setup failure and cancellation stop remaining work with exact usage accounting and fail-safe behavior.
